summary: Build practical UX research and usability testing skills in 5 days. Learn methods, metrics, and reporting you can use immediately.
lede: UX research and usability testing help product teams gather evidence about user needs and observe how people complete interface tasks. For UX researchers, usability analysts, designers, product managers, and business analysts, the course covers planning studies, writing interview and test scripts, and conducting moderated or unmoderated sessions. Learners practice synthesizing observations, assessing usability issues, and communicating prioritized recommendations through reports and stakeholder readouts.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to plan research, test interfaces, and translate findings into product decisions across websites, apps, dashboards, and service journeys.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of digital products, basic product or design terminology, and comfort reading simple charts or spreadsheets. No coding is required for completion. Familiarity with wireframes, task flows, or customer journeys is helpful, and prior exposure to interview notes, survey results, or product analytics will make the exercises easier to apply. Advanced concepts such as sample sizing and qualitative coding are taught at an operational application level, not as statistical engineering.
